final: SELECT COALESCE(o.orderbase, 'NULL') as channel, AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fillcount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) as distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.recordvault) FROM orderexecutions oe2 JOIN orders o2 ON oe2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) as fraction FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase ORDER BY o.orderbase
